hdr.content:
## Workspace Operations by User
Top operations ranked by average response time per user. Uses `calc:service.ptc.action_name_by_user`.

action-by-user.title: Action Name by User — Response Time

queries.expression:
timeseries avg(`calc:service.ptc.action_name_by_user`), by:{Dimension}
| fieldsAdd lastAvg = rollup(avg, value)
| sort lastAvg desc
| limit 50
